HC-1.description: Structural: all required sections present and non-empty.
HC-1.section_rule: Each required section heading must appear at line start. The content between a heading and the next heading (or end of file) must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

HC-2.description: Labeled: HC-1, plus mechanical status-label checks.
HC-2.status_declaration_rule: Every list item (line beginning with '-' or '*') inside the Status Declaration section must match the label pattern.
HC-2.context_rule: The Context section must contain at least one occurrence of the label pattern.
HC-2.known_enforcement_gap: HC-2 as specified requires every behavioral claim in Context to carry a label; mechanically, this validator checks only that labels are used in Context and that all Status Declaration items are labeled. Full claim-level checking requires human or model review. Recorded per INV-11.

HC-3.description: Validated: HC-2, plus every validation checklist item maps to an executable check with reported output. Not mechanically checkable by this validator; requires acceptance review.
